# 271_R6SEC.3 — config/infra hardening cluster (RH-1 + RH-25 + RH-26 + RH-29 + RH-35)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/271_R6SEC.3__config-hardening.md` (carried verbatim from the
`rh-inserts` seed, per the #344 companion convention — self-contained, like 267's precedent).
**Spend:** $0 — no paid legs, no cloud mutations, zero prod writes; read-only
`pulumi config --stack dev` + `git ls-remote` only. **mergePolicy: OPERATOR.**

## What lands

| Finding | Fix |
|---|---|
| **RH-1** — `Pulumi.dev.yaml` committed conflict markers (`pulumi config` unparseable) | Upstream side kept (verified vs `40c3980a^` + post-fix `pulumi config`); new `scripts/check-conflict-markers.mjs` scans every tracked yaml/ts/md via `git ls-files` for `^(<<<<<<<\|=======\|>>>>>>>)`, wired `check:conflict-markers` + always-run `public-safe` step |
| **RH-25** — `.gcloudignore` doesn't exclude `.env*` | `.env`/`.env.*`/`!.env.example` added to `.gcloudignore` **and** `.dockerignore`; `infra/env-ignore.test.ts` pins it |
| **RH-26** — actions on mutable tags + `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` | All 25 external `uses:` SHA-pinned + `# v…` comments (checkout v4.4.0, setup-node v4.4.0, pnpm/action-setup v4.3.0, upload-artifact v4.6.2, gitleaks-action v2.3.9, google auth v2.1.13); journeys SSH leg keyscans the host key through the authenticated IAP tunnel then `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` |
| **RH-29** — previews copy secret values into stack state + send as prod sender | `resend-pull`/`stripe-pull` now pin ENABLED **version numbers** into plain `rhema:nonprodResendVersion`/`rhema:nonprodStripeVersion`; the program mounts `projects/…/versions/<n>` by reference + grants consumer SAs accessor on the shared containers; value configs refused on **every** stage; nonprod `emailFrom: hello@rhema.tools` refused — previews send `previews@rhema.tools`; `Pulumi.pr-230.yaml` cleaned of both `secure:` ciphertexts |
| **RH-35** — prod Cloud SQL accepts unencrypted connections | `sslMode: "ENCRYPTED_ONLY"` on the prod instance; clients already `sslmode=require` |
